description.text:
Collect 151 (收集啦151) is a Simplified Chinese booster series built around the first 151 Pokémon, released in four waves through 2025: 旅 on 17 January, 望 on 18 April, 惊 on 18 July and 聚 on 17 October. All four share one card list. Its 151 main cards give each Pokémon from Bulbasaur to Mew one card, numbered with its National Pokédex number; twelve of them are Pokémon ex, among them Venusaur ex, Charizard ex, Blastoise ex and Mew ex. Every Pokémon that is not an ex also comes as a Poké Ball pattern holo and a rarer Master Ball pattern holo. Pokémon China pitched filling a binder with them as completing a Pokédex.

Each later wave raised the odds of the Poké Ball and Master Ball holos of three types, matching the Pokémon on its pack: Water, Dragon and Colorless in 望; Grass, Psychic and Darkness in 惊, whose pack shows Gengar, Gastly, Ekans and Parasect with Pikachu; and Fire, Lightning and Fighting in 聚, with Vulpix, Pikachu and Cubone. Each wave also had an Art Rare Pikachu by Oswaldo KATO that no other wave holds: in 旅 one leaping across a meadow with Mew, in 望 one beside a dozing Psyduck, in 惊 one with Gengar hiding behind it under a full moon, and in 聚 a crowd of Pikachu playing in a sunny forest with Cubone and Vulpix. 惊 added Special Art Rare Alakazam ex and Mew ex, and 聚 a Special Art Rare Zapdos ex, each only in its wave's packs. From 望 on, 5-card packs held one holo and 20-card packs seven.

Collect 151 reached well beyond the boosters. Free two-card Collect 151 event packs went to players at shop events and for tasks in the official Pokémon card mini program, and from 20 January 2025 came with a KFC meal. Pokémon China made 151 binders, one cover for each Pokémon and 151,000 in all; Master Kong's Xiangbaocui (香爆脆) crispy noodle snack came in 151 packet designs; and from 望 on, coin sets for each of the 151 Pokémon came with every wave. Its main cards are numbered out of 151; the shiny Pokémon cards (S and SSR), four Art Rare Pikachu, the full-art ex, the Special Art Rares and a gold Mew ex are numbered past it, up to 192.

description.text: This Art Rare Pikachu by Oswaldo KATO, leaping across a meadow with Mew floating behind it, came only in packs of 旅 (Journey), the first wave of Collect 151, on sale from 17 January 2025. Each of the four waves had one Art Rare Pikachu by him that the others don't hold, and their pack covers join into one long picture, which Pokémon China first showed with only 旅's quarter colored in.

description.text: This Art Rare Pikachu by Oswaldo KATO, sitting beside a dozing Psyduck with Dragonite flying overhead, came only in packs of 望 (Hope), the second wave of Collect 151, on sale from 18 April 2025, among them the packs in that wave's coin sets. Pokémon China announced it as 望's new Art Rare Pikachu, with more to follow in later waves; Psyduck and Pikachu are on 望's pack too.

description.text: In this Art Rare by Oswaldo KATO, Gengar hides behind a tree at Pikachu's back, as if playing hide-and-seek, while Parasect rests in the distance and Ekans close by, all under a full moon. It came only in packs of 惊 (Surprise), the third wave of Collect 151, on sale from 18 July 2025, among them the packs in that wave's coin sets; the same four Pokémon and Gastly are on 惊's pack.

description.text: This Art Rare by Oswaldo KATO shows a crowd of Pikachu playing together in a sunny forest, with Cubone and Vulpix among them.
